Class SkillsConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.langchain4j.skills.SkillsConfiguration
@EachProperty("langchain4j.skills") public final class SkillsConfiguration extends Object
Configures a set of Agent Skills, exposed as a LangChain4j Skills bean named after the configuration, and offered to the AI services that select it with AiService.skills().

Each skill is a directory with a SKILL.md file, loaded from the classpath and/or the file system. Requires dev.langchain4j:langchain4j-skills on the classpath.

Since:
2.4.0
